text:
Monica (People Ops): New manager playbook + tiny self-review starter posted. TL;DR: keep team OKRs to 3, mark Committed vs Stretch, add 1 dev goal per person, and collect 1-paragraph manager notes. Link: https://redwoodinference.docs/people/manager-playbook-2026
Aaron (Eng Manager): Can you paste the 3-line manager checklist here so I can drop it in our agenda?
Monica (People Ops): Sure — copy/paste: 1) Confirm each team OKR has an owner and a metric; 2) Verify every direct submitted a 1-page self-review + dev goal; 3) Add a 1-2 paragraph manager summary + suggested rating and record 1:1 calibration date.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 1: self-reviews open 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC.
Kim (IC): Tiny self-review starter please? I always struggle with wording.
Monica (People Ops): Paste this micro-template: 
"What I shipped (3 bullets)
Impact (metrics or links)
Roadblocks & learnings
Focus & development goal for next quarter
Support I need from my manager"
Aaron (Eng Manager): Do managers need to use the rubric or is freeform allowed?
Monica (People Ops): Both: use the rating dropdown (Exceeds/Meets/Needs Improvement) and include a short manager note explaining the rationale. Include the calibration 1:1 date.
Kim (IC): For long-running infra work that didn't finish, should I mark it as incomplete?
Monica (People Ops): Document the blocker and new timeline in the review. Managers should evaluate impact and effort; Not delivering due to documented, valid blockers isn't automatic Needs Improvement.
Aaron (Eng Manager): Deadlines?
Monica (People Ops): Self-reviews due 2026-04-10 09:00 UTC; manager reviews due 2026-04-17 17:00 UTC. DM if you need an alternate schedule.
people-ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Company self-review deadline" 2026-04-10 09:00 UTC.
